Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PAGE — Observed surge of incorrect completions + occasional high P50 latency for a small set of tenants. Initial correlates point at prefix/KV cache returning stale entries following yesterday's model variant rollback. Affected patterns: tenant prefixes acct-42/*, acct-99/*, and a group of low-volume customers (cohort-B). Please ack and triage.

Mira Patel: acked. I'm oncall and joining. Can someone pull recent cache hit/miss breakdown and KV eviction logs?

Jonas W.: pulling logs now. Looks like a flurry of cache invalidation events between 11:02–11:06 UTC, but the invalidation pipeline backfilled stale keys into edge nodes due to a race in the rollback ordering.

Samir K.: that matches what I saw in runtime metrics. Two ideas for immediate live mitigation: 1) Per-tenant cache bypass for affected prefixes (fast to flip), 2) Cohort-based throttling to reduce write pressure while we scrub cache.

Mira Patel: prioritize correctness. Do per-tenant bypass first for acct-42 and acct-99. Then enable cohort throttle. Post exact commands here so QA/ops can confirm.

Samir K.: running bypass now — using control plane toggle. Command:```bash
curl -X POST "https://control.redwood.internal/v1/runtime/toggles"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"toggle":"prefix_cache_bypass","tenants":["acct-42","acct-99"],"reason":"stale-entries-after-rollback","operator":"samir"}'
```

DeployBot: deploy accepted, applying toggle to edge clusters (region-us, region-eu). Rolling update in 3 shards. ETA ~90s.

Incident Bot: automation note — toggle application logged (id: tb-7f3a). Monitoring cache hit rate and error surface.

Li Chen: enabling cohort throttle for cohort-B to 5 QPS/adaptive backoff across model-serving pool. Command (rlsctl):```bash
rlsctl set-throttle --cohort "cohort-B" --qps 5 --burst 10 --reason "mitigation: reduce write pressure"
```

Mira Patel: good. Samir, can you also temporarily disable prefix-level pooling (the aggressive prefix cache that de-duplicates requests) for these tenants to avoid stale reuse? That was the root cause during rollback.

Samir K.: disabling pooling now. Small config snippet I applied to runtime:```json
{
  "runtime_feature.flags": {
    "prefix_pooling.enabled": false,
    "prefix_pooling.exempt_tenants": ["acct-42","acct-99"]
  }
}
```

Applied via rbctl with immediate reload.

Jonas W.: I'm watching correctness metrics. Error rate for acct-42 dropped from 6.8% -> 0.7% within 120s of bypass + pooling disable. Latency P50 returned to baseline. Adding a short-lived rewrite job to scrub stale keys from edge caches.

Mira Patel: client impact assessment: affected ~12 tenants, 3 small- to mid-enterprise customers saw incorrect completions (few hundred requests each). No data exfiltration suspected. I'll draft outreach once we stabilize.

Li Chen: I've cut temporary quota for cohort-B to avoid noisy retries:```bash
quotactl update --tenant-group "cohort-B" --max-requests-per-min 300 --reason "mitigation - reduce retries"
```

Incident Bot: mitigation timeline recorded: bypass toggle applied @+00:01:30, pooling disabled @+00:02:10, cohort throttle in place @+00:03:00, quota cap @+00:04:00. Automation monitor set to alert if error rate for any affected tenant >1% for 10m.

Samir K.: rolling cache-scrub job in progress. Job will evict keys matching patterns acct-42/* acct-99/* and then repopulate fresh values with strict TTLs. Scrub command (bg job):```bash
cachectl scrub --pattern "acct-42/*,acct-99/*" --mode evict-write --max-concurrency 20
```

Mira Patel: handoff in ~20 minutes. Summary for next on-call (Li): we have per-tenant bypass + pooling disabled + cohort throttle + quota cap. Scrub job running. Watch for regression in 15–30m and customer DMs / support tickets.

Li Chen: acking handoff. I'll take ownership for next 60m. If scrub fails or error rate bounces back, plan B is to fully disable prefix/KV cache for cohort-B and move traffic to cold path (slower but correct).

Jonas W.: adding note — long-term fix: reorder rollback pipeline to invalidate origin caches before model switch, and add a short grace TTL on rollback variant to prevent immediate stale repopulation. I'll open a PR and link to incident.

Mira Patel: thanks team. Anyone externally contacting customers right now? Need to coordinate wording with support.

Samir K.: nope, waiting for stability signal. Once error rate hits <0.5% for 10m I'll draft a concise note.

DeployBot: scrub job completed on shard-1 and shard-2; shard-3 in progress.

Incident Bot: monitor update — affected error rate down to 0.4% across cohort; latency normalized. Mitigations holding for 12m.

Li Chen: confirmed metrics look stable. I'll keep throttles in place for an hour and then gradually relax with watch windows. Handoff complete, tagging oncall rotation.

Mira Patel: leaving notes in runbook and will add timeline + RCA pointers. If anything noisy appears ping @li directly. :white_check_mark:

Incident Bot: thread archived to incident-tracker (id: INC-2026-0321-07).
